label: downsize-probe-1884
_why: THE DOWNSIZING POLL, THIRD CHECK, AGAINST MORE EVENTS. Probe 2 (20261030_221503) proved the state-list memory (46 of 46 round trips exact, mixed ownership included; 4 unique drops, each matched by a save drop of the same size) but missed SELF-OWNED buildings: `private_ownership_fraction` leaves out a building that owns itself (`identity={ building=<itself> }`), which the engine downsizes as private (12 save-side drops unseen, e.g. fishing wharf 2492). Now private = not owned by a country (`country_ownership_fraction`), and `level >= 1` comes before it (an ownership trigger on a building under its first construction logs an error). 1884-1887 because the vanilla quarterly campaign ran ~12-40 drops a year there (F260's archive) against ~2 a year in 1837-1840. Ground truth: MONTHLY autosaves kept (-KeepSaves) read by ledger/downsize_series.mjs.

_arms.vanilla: {kind: control} - vanilla + telemetry (country_state, downsize_probe, the red-flag feed), continued from the saves_debut vanilla campaign at 1884.1.1

_comparison: every DZ drop against the monthly saves' drops on qualifying buildings (not wholly government-owned, levels - staffing >= 1, staffing < 0.9 x levels), by building id and month: matched, same size, same private split; save-only and poll-only listed; error.log lines naming zzz_v3tb.
_predictions: No zzz_v3tb error line. Tracked a few hundred a poll; tens of drops over the three years, nearly all matched with equal size and private split; save-only only on buildings the poll cannot see (outside the groups, or the last level lost). Magnitudes not argued.
_cost: 1 x 1884 -> 1887 continuation with monthly saves, ~10 min
